falseSynonyms.zh: 記住新資料不等於回想舊資料 memorize 是把資料存進記憶；recall 是把已存的資料再次提取出來。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You memorize a phone number first; later, you recall or remember it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提醒不等於自己想起 remind 通常表示某人或某事令另一個人想起；recall 的主體本身在記起。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The photo reminds her of the trip. She recalls the trip herself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 認出不等於主動回想 recognize 是再次看見或聽見時辨認出熟悉的人或事；recall 是在沒有當前提示下把資訊帶回腦海。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You may recognize a face without being able to recall the person's name.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意識到不等於記起 realize 表示突然理解、察覺或明白某件事；不表示從過去記憶中提取資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She realized the door was unlocked; she recalled locking it earlier.

falseSynonyms.zh: 想像不等於回憶 imagine 可以創造沒有真正發生過的心理畫面；recall 指向過去的記憶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He imagined the future, but recalled the day they first met.

falseSynonyms.zh: 提及不等於記得 mention 只是把事情說出來；一個人可以記得但不提，也可以根據筆記提到自己其實不記得的事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She mentioned the date because it was in her notes, not because she recalled it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意到不等於回想 notice 是當下察覺；recall 是把過去資訊重新帶入意識。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He noticed the sign now and recalled seeing the same sign yesterday.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忘記與回想方向相反 forget 表示資訊無法保留或無法取回；recall/remember 表示成功記起。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She forgot the address at first but later recalled it.
